fusions.name: Curled Charge
fusions.desc: Curls up and rolls into a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 14 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Scale Rattle
fusions.desc: Snaps your scales outward in a ring that deals 5 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Layered Guard
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Overlap the Gaps
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.
